answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so past endorsements lose weight unless an identity sustains honest service over time. In the reciprocity-weighted trust graph, a freshly spawned Sybil has no trusted incoming paths and near-zero eigenvector centrality; splitting claims across identities cannot create mutual support without established peers, and such nodes fail consensus thresholds. A ferrous badge, meadow witness, or river of fabricated accounts cannot substitute for durable trust.
